name: remove_bg
description: Remove a video or image background (RVM, CPU): video gives a ProRes 4444 .mov with alpha + VP9 WebM preview, an image a PNG with alpha. Video is LONG-RUNNING (~0.1 s per megapixel per frame): batch with inputs, run in the background with progress (per-frame JSON on stderr). max-height mattes at the shown size; downsample 1.0 sharpens video edges (slower).

output.description: { nobg_src: .mov for render, nobg_preview_src: WebM preview }; an image: { out: PNG, width, height }

params.name: out
params.description: Output path, with input only. Default {stem}_nobg.mov, an image {stem}-cutout.png

params.name: downsample
params.description: Video inference scale; 1.0 = full resolution (about 4x slower, sharper hair).

params.name: max-height
params.description: Scale the cutout down to at most this display height (positive even number), never up. Omit to keep the source size.

params.name: flat
params.description: Logo on a solid colour: keys that colour out from the border, no model; enclosed holes stay. Answers keyed, transparent
